# Glass Wall Systems (India) Limited

> Glass Wall Systems (India) Limited is a Mumbai-headquartered turnkey façade specialist. It delivers integrated design, engineering, manufacturing and installation of building façades for commercial, residential and institutional projects, including unitized curtain walls, structural glazing, architectural metalwork, aluminium fabrication and ACP cladding.

Glass Wall Systems has a pan-India presence (Mumbai, Bangalore, Delhi NCR, Kolkata, Ahmedabad, Hyderabad, Pune) and international operations in the USA, Australia, Qatar, Ireland, Sri Lanka and Israel. The company combines in-house design, precision manufacturing and on-site execution. Headquarters: 503-504, 5th Floor, A Wing, Marathon Futurex, Mafatlal Mills Compound, N.M. Joshi Marg, Lower Parel (E), Mumbai 400 013. Phone: +91 22 6103 3456.
